definitions.explanation: Literally having the smell of mud or earth, as with freshwater fish or unwashed vegetables.

definitions.gloss: unrefined; rustic; unsophisticated; rough around the edges
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, lacking polish or elegance. Can be used critically to mean crude, or positively to mean earnest and down-to-earth.

⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{釣|つ}った→釣る：01236_tsuru⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{泥臭|どろくさ}いこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
{泥臭|どろくさ}い is an i-adjective combining ⟦{泥|どろ}→泥：03492_doro⟧ (mud) and ⟦{臭|くさ}い→臭い：01133_kusai⟧ (smelling of). The figurative sense (sense 2) can be either negative (crude, unsophisticated) or positive (earnest, gritty, down-to-earth), depending on context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {泥臭|どろくさ}い⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧ (unglamorous effort)
- {泥臭|どろくさ}い⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧ (rough-and-ready approach)
- {泥臭|どろくさ}い⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧ (gritty salesmanship)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{野暮|やぼ}ったい→野暮ったい：09183_yabottai⟧ means unfashionable or unsophisticated in appearance or taste. {泥臭|どろくさ}い emphasizes a raw, unpolished quality that can imply hard work and persistence.
